scripts.build:moon: npm run build:content && moon build cmd/play --target js --release
scripts.build:offline: npm run build && mkdir -p output/builds && zip -q -FS -r output/builds/Tankle-v3-dist.zip README.md Play.command dist -x '*/.DS_Store'
scripts.test: npm run build:content && moon test simulation --target js
scripts.check: npm run build:content && moon check . simulation host renderer cmd/play --target js && npm run test:content && moon test simulation --target js && npm run build
